title: Lighthouse Dragon Dream
description: A surreal fantasy scene depicts a striped green and white lighthouse on a rocky island with its light shining. Two golden dragons form an infinity symbol around it, while a smiling crescent moon, a wizard on a broom, a woman in red on one dragon, and a woman in yellow holding a glowing orb float in the purple night sky. In the foreground, a man in military camouflage stands in reflective water surrounded by a glowing circular portal showing a waterfall landscape. The water mirrors the entire scene, with colorful flowers and hot air balloons visible.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal fantasy painting featuring a green and white striped lighthouse on rocks in the sea. Two golden oriental dragons coil into an infinity loop around the tower. A smiling crescent moon with a face hangs in a deep purple starry sky as a blue-robed wizard flies on a broom casting lightning. A woman in flowing red robes rides one dragon holding a glowing orb, while a woman in a yellow dress stands among vibrant flowers holding another orb. In the foreground, a man in full military camouflage stands in shallow reflective water inside a glowing circular portal revealing a mountain waterfall. Hot air balloons float in the distance, rich colors, intricate details, dreamlike atmosphere.
